item.description:
Carry on a sentence. Delete the full stop and dictate again, and the new words join the sentence you were in: a space only where the words would touch, a small letter where the sentence continues, and a capital kept where it is the word's own. The app knows the text before the caret whenever it is the tail of its own paste. A dictation begun while the last one was still landing no longer loses either.

Draft keeps the shape of your words. A word you said in full stays in full: "cannot", "I am", "we will" and "do not" no longer come back as "can't", "I'm", "we'll" and "don't", and a contraction you said is yours to keep. Draft and Prompt run about a fifth faster: at each step the model checks a guess taken from your own words and keeps it only where it would have chosen that word anyway, so the text is still the model's own. A rewrite that runs past the length limit stops there instead of finishing first. Your opening "No," is no longer a reason to set a rewrite aside, and a rewrite that turned you into the person you were addressing is.

Spoken symbols, addresses and spellings. "Dash", "underscore" and "dot" join the words around them where a file name or a flag is meant — issue-licence.py, --no-cache, .env — and stay words where they are words. An email address, a web address, a path or a slash command said on its own is typed exactly, with no full stop after it. Your own spelling of a term beats the bundled dictionaries', and a dictionary line typed with either apostrophe matches both.

Statistics, and what the app notices. Settings → Statistics opens a window of dials and meters — words and minutes this week and all time, and what the week saved against typing — and the week's words per minute sits in the front page's corner. Now and then the front page carries a Noticed card: rewrites set aside more than usual, or a name you have dictated several ways, with the spellings to pick from. Record dictations is on unless you switched it off; you are told once, as your first words land. Words are cleared after 90 days, the counts stay, and Settings → "Forget my dictations" clears them now. Nothing leaves your Mac.

Missed a release? 0.18.2 read a full stop before "which" or "because" as the pause it was, applied your dictionary before the model sees the text, and stopped long Clean dictations waiting through two timeouts. 0.18.1 fixed a blank words-per-minute figure for anyone with Record dictations off. 0.18.0 put right a fortnight of real dictation (postcodes, spoken amounts, email addresses), kept your opening Yes or No in Draft and Prompt, and added the Statistics row. Every release, in order: github.com/romeo-golf-software/dictation-releases/releases.
